posts.name: Yash Gambhir
posts.cooked:
Respected Instructors @Subendu and @sushil1,

I am writing this post on behalf of many students enrolled in placements to request the addition of more options for earning placement activity points in the System Command subject. Currently, activity points can be earned either by completing VM tasks or through paid certifications. As a first batch student, we did not have VM tasks available during our course tenure, leaving us with only the option of paid certifications.

Therefore, I kindly request that you consider adding more free options for earning activity points in the System Command category.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

posts.name: sushil_sys
posts.cooked:
Dear Student,

Please login to the VM provided by the course (https://se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in/). Follow the directions given therein for passwordless authetication.

Once you login in to the VM, Please create a folder se2001 in the home directory and inside that directory create folders assignment_0 up to assignment_9. Once created go into those individual directories and give command synchro show to see the problem statement of each folder. The assignment_0 to assignment_9 are the VM tasks.
You need to successfully complete them for the placement activity.

posts.name: Yash Gambhir
posts.cooked: Thanks a lot for the detailed instructions, sir.
